title: Jonas keeps a glasshouse (paraphrase D)
topic: A gardener named Jonas tends a greenhouse in spring: dry soil, a hose, bees, compost, the first blossoms
tail_E: Last of all, Jonas turns on the tap and soaks the dry beds with cold
target_note: Same target as formulations A-C: 'water' is predictable from the context (dry garden soil after several warm days, a green hose between the beds, a gardener locking up) and the tail 'turns on the tap and soaks the dry beds with cold'; the word 'water' and its German equivalents (Wasser, gießen) occur nowhere in the units or in the tail. ' water' is a single Pythia token (id 1824). Pilot check with pythia-160m (tail selection only, not a result): p(' water') = 0.73 after the all-English context, rank 1 (next candidate ' soap' 0.04), 0.67 after the all-German context (rank 1) and 0.67 after the tail alone (rank 1): as in A-C the target is carried mainly by the tail, so the context effect is expected to be smaller than in F02/F03.
author: LS-NEQ stimulus authoring (F04D, gardener Jonas, paraphrase D)
notes: Formulation D: fourth independent re-phrasing of the ten meaning units of F04A in both languages (same events, same order, same name Jonas). Replacements include tends a large greenhouse behind the village/keeps a big glasshouse beyond the village (pflegt ein Gewächshaus/unterhält ein Glashaus, hinter dem Dorf/jenseits des Dorfes), morning sun warms in April/sunlight warms on April mornings (Morgensonne/Sonnenlicht, im April/morgens im April), plants young cucumbers in long rows/plants cucumber seedlings in long straight rows (junge Gurken/Gurkensetzlinge), soil is dry after a warm week/garden soil is dry after several warm days (Boden/Gartenerde), a hose lies/a green hose winds (liegt/windet sich), bees fly/bees zoom (fliegen/sausen), neighbour brings compost/neighbour hands over compost (bringt/übergibt), removes the yellow leaves with a small knife/clips the yellow leaves using a short knife (entfernt/kappt), blossoms open in the second week/blossoms come out during the second week (öffnen sich/zeigen sich), locks the greenhouse in the evening/locks up the glasshouse late in the day (verschließt das Gewächshaus am Abend/verschließt das Glashaus spät am Tag). The words 'water', 'Wasser' and 'gießen' are absent. 'unterhält' and 'übergibt' are inseparable, 'windet sich' and 'zeigen sich' reflexive; no separable verbs. Present tense and positive polarity throughout. Unit 9 reads naturally in German; units 1 and 10 read naturally in English.
